test_cases.name: Verbose quote request with non-catalog item and available items
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several catalog items and includes a non-catalog item that cannot be mapped, triggering an intervention.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Multiple Produce Items and Specialty Product
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out from Fresh Foods North Europe to request a detailed quote for an upcoming procurement cycle. We are looking to source a variety of fresh produce and related items for our distribution centers. Please include the following in your quote:

- Organic Carrot (please quote for 50 units)
- Kalamata Olive (20 units)
- Watermelon (10 units)
- Please also include a quote for "Sunrise Heirloom Tomato" (30 units), as this is a specialty item we are interested in evaluating for our premium product line. If you need any additional details about this item, let me know, but we are specifically looking for the Sunrise Heirloom variety.

If you require further information to process this request, please advise. We would appreciate receiving the quote at your earliest convenience, as we are finalizing our supplier selection this week.

Best regards,
Fresh Foods North Europe

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request with intervention-triggering unknown item
test_cases.description: A verbose and polite customer requests a quote for several items, including one that does not exist in the catalog, requiring intervention. The email provides extra context and explanations, but at least one line item cannot be matched to the available catalog.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Toys, Tools, and Specialty Item
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out on behalf of Danish Pastry to request a detailed quote for a selection of items we are considering for our upcoming promotional event. We are aiming to diversify our offerings and would appreciate your assistance in providing pricing and availability information.

Specifically, please include the following items in the quote:

- 10 units of the SmartToys Building Blocks, as these have been highly recommended by several of our partners for their educational value.
- 5 Screwdrivers (Item No: AITEM-0042), which we plan to use as part of a DIY workshop for children.
- 1 MagicToyland Deluxe Castle Playset (this is a specialty item we heard about from another supplier; please include it if available, as we are particularly interested in its features for themed events).

If you require any additional information or clarification regarding our request, please let me know. We would appreciate a comprehensive quote that includes all applicable taxes, shipping costs, and estimated delivery timelines. Thank you very much for your attention and support.

Best regards,
Danish Pastry

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request with non-catalog item and informal tone

The request includes extra context and explanations, and the intervention trigger is the inclusion of a product that does not exist in the catalog.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request – Toys, Snacks, and Special Item
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

I hope you’re having a good week! I’m reaching out because I’d like to get a quote for a few things for our upcoming event at the bakery. We’re planning a kids’ corner and some snack tables, so I want to make sure we have a mix of toys and food items. Here’s what I’m looking for:

- 2 sets of the JoySprout Toy Car Set (these are always a hit with the kids!)
- 1 Rug (for the play area, any of your available options should work)
- 10 bottles of Soda – Medium (refreshments for the snack table)
- 5 packs of Kalamata Olive (for the adults, if possible)
- And, I’d also like to include a quote for your "Bakery Play Set" – I saw something similar at another event and thought it would be perfect for us. If you carry anything like that, please add it to the quote.

If you need any more details from me, just let me know. Thanks for helping us put together something fun!

Best,
Jakob Kuhs

Best regards,
Jakob Kuhs
